tools.name: url_probe
tools.description: Call when you need a cheap reachability/health check before a heavier fetch. Probes a public http(s) URL (HEAD, GET fallback): status, final URL, content-type, timing. No full body download (GET peeks ≤8KB). SSRF-safe public hosts only. Not for authenticated or private network URLs. Price: $0.03 USD

tools.name: json_shape
tools.description: Call when you have messy text (JSON blob or key:value lines) and need a heuristic object shaped by schema_hint — no LLM. Cap 50k chars. Use to normalize tool dumps before structured follow-up. Not for NLP understanding or free-form writing. Price: $0.15 USDC per call (x402 on Base) or 1 prepaid pack

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: url_probe, watch_once · Private data: url_probe, page_extract · Public sink: watch_once.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: url_probe, watch_once · Private data: url_probe, page_extract · Public sink: watch_once

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
